## Who We Are

EzzyDelivery is Qatar's trusted delivery and logistics partner, founded in 2017 to make e-commerce delivery easy and reliable for businesses across Qatar. We serve over 600 active businesses with 1,000+ daily deliveries and maintain a 98% on-time delivery rate.

## Core Services

### 1. Same-Day Delivery Qatar
- Pickup within 2 hours of booking
- Delivery by end of day across Doha, Al Wakrah, Lusail
- Starting from QAR 15
- Available 7 days a week
- URL: /same-day-delivery-qatar/

### 2. Courier Service Qatar
- Standard courier: QAR 8 (24-48 hour delivery)
- Express courier: QAR 15 (same-day delivery)
- Document, parcel, and B2B deliveries
- GPS tracking and proof of delivery included
- URL: /courier-service-qatar/

### 3. Express Delivery Qatar
- 2-hour pickup guarantee
- 4-6 hour delivery for urgent shipments
- Priority handling and notifications
- Starting from QAR 25
- URL: /express-delivery-qatar/

### 4. Last Mile Delivery
- 95% first-attempt success rate
- E-commerce fulfillment optimization
- Real-time GPS tracking
- Professional trained drivers
- URL: /last-mile-delivery-qatar/

### 5. 3PL Services Qatar
- Full third-party logistics
- Warehousing and inventory management
- Order fulfillment (pick, pack, ship)
- Monthly volume pricing available
- URL: /3pl-qatar/
